correctness.rationale: Exact multiplicative prime-power ratios and exact prime exponent densities lead to a sufficient strict-inequality event after excluding the zero-density P-smooth exception. For a positive rational ratio log r, T20((A-C)/(A+C)) - 2|u|^41/[41(1-u^2)] is a rational certified lower bound; floored grid bins at B=100000 cannot overstate log ratios. Each bin dynamic-programming recurrence floors integer contributions downward at scale 10^18, and discards exponents outside p^(a+1)<10^12 without renormalization. Independently reimplemented 96-prime Fraction atanh+bin recursion (not the provided script), reproduced good integer mass 771520086457799875, p2(2)=p3(2)=-18233 and p5(1)=18232. Equality cylinders disjoint from bin>=0 have score -1 and weights (1/20+1/45)*prod_{p<=503}(1-1/p); tail squarefreeness >=502/503. Exact final rational bound 0.77643235635205 > 1941/2500. Infinite density is supported by known limiting distribution theorem, while the lower-density bound itself follows directly from the cylinder sieve.
residual_risks: Does not determine or optimize the density; finite prime restriction deliberately omits many qualifying n.
Natural-density existence uses a cited classical limiting-distribution fact; even absent existence, the same lower asymptotic density inequality holds.
